title: Keep a List of Victories
verse: the king of Tirzah (one),a total of thirty-one kings.
observation: Joshua kept a record of all the victories the Lord led them to. This is so important to us today. We need to have a list of victories so we can pull back and remember God’s goodness. I heard of a guy who keeps a mental record of all the bad things people have said about him so when he feels unmotivated, he can remember and work harder. That sounds like a miserable life. Instead, remember God’s faithfulness and realize that if He did it before, He can do it again.
application: Journal something you are thankful for every day.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us keep Your goodness close to mind.
